2609.00859.title: Reinforcement Learning Enhanced LLM Agents for Complex Vehicle Routing Problems
2609.00859.paper_summary: Vehicle Routing Problems (VRPs) are fundamental combinatorial optimization problems with widespread applications in various scenarios. The advanced optimization solvers can effectively solve such problems. However, modeling complex VRP variants for solvers often requires substantial domain expertise, which limits the accessibility of advanced optimization technologies. In this paper, we propose Reinforcement Learning Enhanced LLMAgents(RLEA), a multi-agent framework designed to automate the modeling of complex VRPs. RLEA introduces a lightweight neural Planner trained with Soft Q-learning to efficiently orchestrate the actions of LLM-based agents. In addition, we equip the system with an evolutionary memory module and retrieval-augmented generation, enabling the agent to leverage both accumulated experience and external solver knowledge during program generation and refinement for solving VRPs. We evaluated 48 distinct VRP variants across various solvers. The experimental results demonstrate that RLEA outperforms the previous state-of-the-ar method, achieving a 16.67% higher success rate while significantly reducing runtime errors. These results validate that integrating reinforcement learning with LLM-based reasoning is highly effective for automated optimization modeling. The appendix is available at: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19134435.
2609.00859.paper_summary_zh: 車輛路徑問題（VRPs）是基本的組合優化問題，在各種場景中有廣泛的應用。<lb/>先進的優化求解器可以有效地解決這類問題。<lb/>然而，為求解器建模複雜的VRP變體通常需要大量的領域專業知識，這限制了先進優化技術的可及性。<lb/>在本文中，我們提出了增強型強化學習LLMAgents（RLEA），這是一個旨在自動化複雜VRP建模的多代理框架。<lb/>RLEA引入了一個輕量級的神經規劃器，使用軟Q學習進行訓練，以有效協調基於LLM的代理的行動。<lb/>此外，我們為系統配備了一個進化記憶模塊和檢索增強生成，使代理能夠在生成和完善程序以解決VRP時利用累積的經驗和外部求解器知識。<lb/>我們在各種求解器上評估了48個不同的VRP變體。<lb/>實驗結果表明，RLEA的成功率比之前的最先進方法高出16.67%，同時顯著減少了運行時錯誤。<lb/>這些結果驗證了將強化學習與基於LLM的推理相結合在自動化優化建模中是非常有效的。<lb/>附錄可在以下鏈接獲得：https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19134435。
